newsitem.title: USA: Autocam buys Hamilton, sees higher earnings.
newsitem.headline: Autocam buys Hamilton, sees higher earnings.

text.p: Autocam Corp said Monday it purchased the net assets of The Hamilton Group Inc for about $18 million and expects the acquisition to add 15 percent to Wall Street earnings estimates.
In recent fiscal years, Hamilton has posted revenues of $13 million to $15 million, Autocam said.
"(O)nce the two companies are fully integrated, earnings accretion of approximately 15 percent over current fiscal 1998 street estimates can be expected," the company said in a statement.
According to First Call, the consensus of analysts' estimates for Autocam's fiscal 1998 earnings is $1.22 a share. Autocam, which provides precision-machined parts, said its fiscal 1998 began today.
Autocam said it expects to finance the purchase through borrowings from its primary lending institutions.
Hamilton, with manufacturing facilities in Dowagiac, Michigan and Gaffney, South Carolina, manufactures precision-machined parts primarily for the automotive industry.
Autocam said the acquisition is consistent with the company's objectives. It said Hamilton will broaden its product offerings for the braking industry and expand its relationships with key customers.
